title: crash_instinct — plan 4 (9,4 → 12,07 s, images 282-362)
notes: Suite de la même prise (aucune coupe avant 22,9 s, PI-020) ; le fouetté 282-285 cache un saut dans le temps. Analyse : references/crash_instinct/shots/s04.md. Plan écrit et contrôlé AVANT la construction. Temps relatifs au début du plan (image 282 = 0 s).

voice.text: somehow, somebody hits it every week.

characters.notes: assis au volant, vu à travers le pare-brise ; projeté en avant au choc

shots.narration: somehow, somebody hits it every week.
shots.transition_in: no cut: whip from the road view (frame 282) through the foliage onto the sign (285); the swap (white wreck and planter out, sign in) happens off-frame inside the whip
shots.transition_out: dissolve to shot 5 (frame 363): the planter on a ladder at the trunk

camera.move: lands from the whip, short settle
fast pull back across the road

actions.what: a blue car comes fast along the verge from the right of the frame, brakes, skids toward the trunk
actions.anim: keyed path, wheels turn, nose dips
consequences: skid marks in the gravel and flattened grass stay

actions.what: hits the trunk, front crushed, the rear lifts and drops back
actions.anim: shape key crash_dent, pitch 0 -> 24 deg -> 0 with a bounce
reactions: dust burst at the foot of the trunk
consequences: the car stays crushed against the trunk and smokes

actions.what: the front wheel rolls to the foot of the sign, wobbles and falls flat on the old tyre
actions.anim: keyed roll (rotation = distance / radius), tip over
reactions: small dust puff when it lands
the old tyre squashes a little
consequences: a stack of two tyres stays at the foot of the sign

actions.what: the split-flap digit flips from 7 to 0
actions.anim: top flap rotates 180 deg about the hinge, 0 behind
micro: the sign shakes at the impact (frame 318)
